reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is user-facing update notification within the DSH web interface: it checks the npm registry for newer @deepseek-ai/dsh versions, shows a sidebar footer notice only when an update exists, and offers quick actions (copy update command / open npm link) with per-version dismiss state.

summaries.zh: 一个 DSH Web 插件，用于检测 @deepseek-ai/dsh 的新版本并在侧边栏提醒有可用更新，支持一键复制更新命令或打开 npm 页面。
summaries.en: A DSH web plugin that detects newer @deepseek-ai/dsh versions and shows a sidebar notice when an update is available, with quick actions to copy the update command or open the npm page.

capabilities: Queries npm registry for package version metadata
Displays update notices in the DSH web sidebar
Provides one-click update command copy and npm link actions
Persists dismissed update version in browser localStorage
